div.div: The hook is inlined into each caller's own slot list. Sharing the value needs context or a store — a hook alone never does it.

div.div: Name it useX only if it calls a hook. A useFormatPrice that touches nothing React-shaped is a helper wearing a costume, and the linter will hold it to rules it does not need.
